payload.title: Assistant Relationship Manager at Minet Kenya
payload.introduction: Minet is a trusted pan-African advisor that meets the uncertainties of tomorrow by delivering risk and human capital solutions today. As the largest Aon Global Network Correspondent, Minet has access to a network of over 50,000 colleagues in 120 countries as well as proprietary data, research and analytics which enable us to manage and secure the risks of tomorrow and provide clients with an unrivalled advantage.
payload.description:
Purpose for the Job

To support the effective delivery of client relationship and administration services for umbrella schemes by assisting the Relationship Manager in daily client interactions, documentation, compliance tracking, and coordination of internal service teams. The Assistant Relationship Manager contributes to maintaining high client satisfaction, upholding regulatory standards, and supporting scheme governance and reporting obligations in line with the Retirement Benefits Act, Income Tax Act, and Trust Deeds.

Duties and Responsiblities

Client Support and Relationship Coordination


	Assist in managing assigned umbrella fund schemes by supporting client and Trustee engagements, including scheduling meetings, preparing packs, and recording follow-up items.
	Maintain regular contact with clients to ensure timely updates on administrative or operational issues.
	Support the Relationship Manager in maintaining client satisfaction and promoting a service-driven culture.


Scheme Documentation and Reporting


	Assist in preparing quarterly scheme reports, AGM packs, investment summaries, and statutory returns.
	Help maintain audit-ready scheme files and ensure documentation is properly archived and accessible.
	Support the coordination of client audits and regulatory inspections by compiling required information in a timely manner.


Compliance and Governance Support


	Track and follow up on statutory submissions such as RBA filings, KRA approvals, and board resolutions.
	Maintain compliance checklists and assist in preparing regulatory correspondence and trustee communications.
	Monitor timelines for member notifications, circulars, and governance deliverables.


Internal Coordination


	Liaise with Administration, Fund Accounting, Legal, and Compliance teams to facilitate delivery of scheme services, including contributions, benefit payments, and scheme updates.
	Assist in resolving service issues by documenting concerns, coordinating action items, and ensuring feedback loops with internal teams.
	Coordinate the onboarding and transition of new participating employers under umbrella schemes.


Member Communication and Issue Handling


	Assist in preparing and distributing circulars, member statements, and other scheme communication materials.
	Respond to standard queries from members and employers, escalating complex or technical issues to the Relationship Manager.
	Track member queries and ensure resolution timelines are monitored and documented.


Key Competencies

Knowledge And Skills Required


	The Retirement Benefits Act, Income Tax Act, and Trust Deeds.
	Basic contribution and benefit processing workflows.
	Scheme reporting cycles, client SLAs, and documentation standards.
	Member and employer engagement protocols.
	Minimum of 4 years' experience in pension administration, client servicing, or financial services operations.
	Experience with umbrella schemes, member communication, or scheme goveance processes is an added advantage.
	Exposure to working in a regulated pension or financial services environment is desirable.
	Proficient in Microsoft Office and basic pension reporting tools.


Professional and Academic Qualifications


	Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Actuarial Science, or a related field.
	Certified Pension Manager (CPM) qualification or a Diploma in Insurance.

payload.description:
Purpose for the Job

Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and confidence in the company's pension services. Act as the primary liaison between Boards of Trustees, scheme members, service providers, and regulatory bodies, including the Retirement Benefits Authority (RBA) and Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA). Address client inquiries, resolve issues, and provide guidance on pension-related matters, work closely with internal teams to ensure effective service delivery and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsiblities

Client Relationship Management:


	Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with clients.
	Understand client's unique pension needs and provide tailored solutions.
	Act as the main point of contact for clients, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly.
	Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery.


Pension Industry Expertise:


	Develop and maintain a deep understanding of pension regulations, policies, and industry trends.
	Provide clients with expert guidance on pension plan options, investment strategies, and retirement planning.
	Facilitate the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a smooth transition and understanding of services.
	Conduct client education sessions on pension plans, benefits, and any changes in regulatory environment.


Issue Resolution:


	Proactively identify and address client issues, collaborating with the pension administration team and other internal departments to ensure timely resolution.
	Investigate and resolve complex client inquiries related to pension administration.


Communication and Reporting:


	Prepare and present periodic reports on scheme performance, account status, and key developments.
	Keep Trustees informed of regulatory and policy changes affecting their schemes.
	Provide management with client feedback and recommendations to improve processes and service delivery.


Compliance:


	Oversee pension scheme service delivery to achieve agreed performance, quality, and customer care standards.
	Coordinate with the Fund Accounting team to ensure the timely preparation and filing of audited scheme financial statements in accordance with statutory requirements.
	Ensure compliance with applicable pension regulations, statutory obligations, and ISO standards, including timely closure of audit findings and non-conformities.


Business Development & Growth:


	Participating in business development to ensure growth of the pension book as per the department's budgets and organizations' goals.
	Ensure that all client debt is collected within 60 days of being invoiced. This involves ensuring that all clients pay competitive fees.


Key Competencies


	Client-focused, professional, and discreet in handling client matters.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex information and communicate it clearly.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels.
	Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently and collaboratively.
	Adaptable to changing client needs and industry developments.
	Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
	Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Knowledge of pension administration software is an added advantage.


Knowledge And Skills Required

EXPERIENCE


	5+ years of experience in client relationship management, preferably within the pension administration, financial services, or insurance industries.
	Proven track record of managing complex client relationships and delivering excellent service.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS


	Strong understanding of defined benefit (DB) and defined contribution (DC) pension schemes, scheme rules, goveance, and the applicable regulatory framework.
	Knowledge of pension administration systems and the ability to interpret scheme reports and provide informed guidance to clients.


Professional and Academic Qualifications


	Bachelor's degree in Business, Statistics, or a related field.
	A Master's degree in a business-related field is an added advantage.
	Membership in a relevant professional association or institute is an added advantage.
	Certified Pension Manager (CPM) qualification or a Diploma in Insurance.

payload.title: Computer Studies & ICT Teacher at Makini High School
payload.introduction:
Makini Schools is a leader in the Kenyan system of education - drawing on global best practice - with five campuses in Nairobi & Kisumu, offering nursery, primary and high school education.
We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:
payload.description:
Key Qualifications and Experience Required:


	At least five years demonstrable teaching experience in a recognized School preferably one delivering the Competency Based Education Curriculum.
	Bachelor of Education degree with specialization in ICT/Computer Science major from a recognized institution.
	A Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of ICT, supplemented by a Diploma in Technical Teacher Education or a Postgraduate Diploma in Education (PGDE)
	Experience in coding and robotics will be an added advantage
	Must be registered with the Teachers Service Commission (TSC)


Skills, knowledge, abilities & values:


	Demonstrate a good knowledge and understanding of current educational issues relating to the specialist subject areas
	Strong leadership skills Interpersonal skills
	Embrace team spirit
	Ability to work with a diverse student body • Self-driven
	Be willing to inspire, challenge, motivate and empower students
